prerequisites: Entered on the list of UTH students

learning_outcomes.text: Developing integrated language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing)
Developing communicative and sociolinguistic language competences within a specific professional field.
Making aware of the relationship between one's own culture and foreign cultures.
Preparing to participate in professional life and undertake language activities in your field. Overcoming psychological and mental barriers in the use of professional German.
He has general knowledge and knowledge of grammatical structures that allow him to understand and create written and oral communications for professional use in the German language.
He knows the customs and rules of conduct in a foreign language culture in the private and professional spheres.
He knows and understands the vocabulary in the field of study.
He can use the German language at a communicative level at the B2 level in the field of study.
He can search, analyze and use information from different sources in the German language.
He is able to create coherent oral and written statements in a wide range of topics of the studied field of study.
He is able to work and interact in a German-speaking group, taking various roles in it.

syllabus_topics: Office supplies and equipment, placing orders
Services. Service facility offer. Offers, instructions, commands, polite questions and requests
Computer use - work in Windows, e-mail
Company: Positions and functions, professions. Introducing, getting acquainted, receiving a guest in the company
Company presentation (headquarters, areas of activity, organizational structure)
Telephone communication in the workplace (common phrases and expressions, making appointments, canceling and rescheduling appointments, leaving messages for absent persons)
Measuring instruments, quantities and units of measurement. Tools, devices, materials
Systems that increase safety and driving comfort

Grammar: negation, numerals, noun inflection, adjective inflection and gradation, reflexive verbs, modals, separable and inseparable verbs, Perfect tense, Präteritum tense. complex clauses, passive voice, imperative mood, conditional mood
teaching_methods: Activating methods (case method, situational method, didactic games, seminar, didactic discussion)

assessment_methods.method: Passing an original specialist text (presentation in a foreign language)

assessment_rules: The condition for obtaining credit is to achieve all required learning outcomes. Obtaining positive grades in all forms of classes leads to passing the course and obtaining the ECTS points. The final grade for classes, on a scale of 2-5, is based on active participation, tests, presentations, oral and written statements, and passing an original specialist text. The specific weighting for classes is 40% test, 30% activity in class, and 30% independent work.
